<thought>To identify the individual fragments that can be linked to form the molecule (C₇H₁₂N₂O) I need to see which carbons are attached to which hydrogens. The HSQC spectrum will map each carbon chemical shift to its directly bonded proton(s), allowing me to separate the carbonyl carbon, aromatic carbons, methylene carbon(s), and the five methyl groups. This information will let me construct a minimal set of SMILES fragments that can be joined to reproduce the whole structure.</thought>
